Open follow-ups: POSTMORTEM_DRAFT, CAPACITY_REVIEW, DATA_BACKFILL.

No changes.md. inventory-svc dns SERVFAIL kms.internal continues (round-09/logs/inventory-svc.log:7,13,22,44,66,75,80); NEW shipping-svc also dns lookup failed kms.internal (round-09/logs/shipping-svc.log:17,38,57,58,66,78) -> Thread B DNS affects inventory-svc+shipping-svc.
